#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Start service with "sudo systemctl start sonic-hostservice"
4. Check service with "sudo systemctl status sonic-hostservice"

Can't start sonic-hostservice

#### Describe the results you expected:
Can start sonic-hostservice
